_about: F78 THE LADDER — every rank gate in Goops, in one file (Muzzy 2026-11-02: "ensure the architecture makes pivots like this easier"). Each gate is a NAMED beat with one rank; every system asks the ladder by name (src/progress/ladder.ts: rankOf("wildGoop")), so moving a beat — or reshaping the whole climb — is numbers here and nowhere else. Read live: a Dev Kit edit applies while the game runs. The ladder module: src/ladder/ (README). Groups: beats (the gates), titles, upgrades, story (moments), grants (extra scraps on a beat's rank).

_help.maxRank: The top rank (ranks run 0 to this). The final shift is its own beat (beats.finalShift).
_help.beats: Every rank gate in the game, by name. Move one = change one number here; the running game follows (Dev Kit). Code and tests ask the ladder by name (src/progress/ladder.ts rankOf), never a rank number.
_help.titles: The rank each title starts at (design/story.md "Rank titles"), in rank order; words: en.json story.titles. A new title shows on the payday that reaches it. The 12th title is the win, not a rank.
_help.upgrades: The rank each upgrade can be bought from (content/tuning/upgrades.json has the rest; the shop itself opens at beats.upgradesShop). Moving an upgrade = one number here.
_help.story: Which rank each story moment plays at (content/story/moments.json "moments"; ids are the ranks they were written for in the 51-rank story — the ladder says where they play now). More than one moment on a rank is fine: they play in this file's order.
_help.grants: Extra rewards on a beat's rank, on top of the usual (progression.json scrapsPerRank): scraps = { beat: how many } (e.g. "veteranCaught": 8 — his emergency transfer). Empty = none.
_help.beats.firstDay: The first day: where every step table starts (4 colours, no junk) and the always-open fines.
_help.beats.nextPiece: The next-piece window at the top of the tank opens (an unlock lesson plays).
_help.beats.visorBreaks: The visor (RESET LIGHTS) can break from here (its breakdown lesson plays).
_help.beats.swap: Swapping the falling piece with the next one opens (hold Right Shift / R, or hold still on the tank).
_help.beats.junk1: The first floor junk: shift.json junkByBeat says how many single goop cells sit on the floor from here (5).
_help.beats.whisperCold: The first in-shift whisper ("…cold…", once per device — one you'll doubt).
_help.beats.laserBreaks: The laser can break from here.
_help.beats.upgradesShop: The Upgrades button on the console opens (scraps bank from rank 1 either way).
_help.beats.controlsBreak: The controls can break from here.
_help.beats.facesOn: Tiny eyes open in big clumps (eyes.json: minClump10 / eyeChance10).
_help.beats.noVoices: Management answers each whisper: "THERE ARE NO VOICES IN THE TANK…".
_help.beats.fineHearingVoices: The silly fine "hearing voices" can show from here (payslip.json sillyFines).
_help.beats.fineTalkingToGoop: The silly fine "talking to the goop" can show from here.
_help.beats.twoColourPieces: Some pieces fall in two colours (twists.json split).
_help.beats.lateLooks: Eyes in most clumps, following the falling piece (eyes.json minClump20 / eyeChance20, follow*).
_help.beats.cracksGrow: Cracks grow into the cells next to them (twists.json grow). The crack quota eases from here (shift.json quota.addByBeat).
_help.beats.veteranCaught: The Veteran is caught: the first report from here fines YOU once ("Association with a retired employee"), paydays use the after-capture words, and the passage debt only grows (payslip.json debt).
_help.beats.worried: Eyes blink and look worried when pressure is high (eyes.json blink*, worried*, brow*).
_help.beats.whiteGoop: The white goop (the Veteran, gooped) is in the tank from here.
_help.beats.pendingRetirement: From the shift that reaches this rank, every report lists you under "Pending retirements".
_help.beats.wildGoop: Some pieces are wild goop (twists.json wild).
_help.beats.mouths: Some clumps grow mouths (eyes.json mouth*, talk*).
_help.beats.quotaEaseEnds: The crack quota's ease (from cracksGrow) ends here (shift.json quota.addByBeat).
_help.beats.fineTalkingBack: The silly fine "talking back" can show from here.
_help.beats.hatch: The hatch under the console shows (it was always there; nobody looked).
_help.beats.eyesChorus: The first shift from here (once per device) every mouth in the tank opens at once (eyes.json chorus*).
_help.beats.finalShift: The final shift is played at this rank (the boss level — finalShift.json).
